To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) patients with advanced melanoma treated with ipilumumab (ipi) had increased cytokine production by peripheral blood mononuclear (PBMC) cells in response to NYESO-1 stimulation, (ii) patients with increased cytokine production tended to have better recurrence free survival and (iii) these findings suggest that the cytokine profile of circulating PBMC cells may be a useful biomarker for ipi therapy in melanoma.
